comparison: Perfect agreement on enhancer identification (C6, C86-C91). Both evaluations find the evidence compelling, with OpenEval highlighting convergence of ATAC-seq, Cut&Run, and transgenic data, while peer reviewers emphasize therapeutic implications for HC-specific gene delivery.

Strong agreement on epistatic relationship (C5, C74-C76). Both accept that RBM24 loss does not affect POU4F3 or GFI1 expression. OpenEval emphasizes the mosaic approach providing internal controls, while peer reviewers accept findings as consistent with demonstrated regulatory hierarchy.

Strong agreement on POU4F3 regulation of RBM24 (C3, C44, C47-C48, C55). Both find evidence compelling from multiple Pou4f3 mutant models. OpenEval includes C43 and emphasizes convergence of two independent models, while peer review includes C64 (cell-autonomous nature). All reviewers accept this as well-demonstrated.

Agreement on GFI1 independence (C4, C65-C66, C68, C72). Both accept that RBM24 expression persists without GFI1. OpenEval includes additional claims (C67, C69-C70) and emphasizes temporal analysis before HC degeneration, while peer reviewers accept the finding without challenge.

Agreement on negative rescue result (C7, C95-C98) but different interpretations. Both accept the data showing RBM24 cannot rescue Pou4f3-/- HC death. OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED and suggests RBM24 is not the sole critical target, while peer reviewers question the rationale for the experiment, noting the result is unsurprising given POU4F3 regulates many genes.

Partial overlap on HC survival data (C51-C54). OpenEval focuses specifically on quantitative HC survival analysis with statistical validation, rating it SUPPORTED. Peer review R6 includes these claims within broader context of temporal degeneration patterns (C1-C2, C67, C102, C106), accepting findings but noting they largely confirm previous work.

Overlap on temporal degeneration patterns (C1-C2). OpenEval R6 focuses on establishing temporal differences across genotypes with literature support, rating SUPPORTED. Peer review R6 covers broader scope including these claims plus HC survival data, accepting findings but emphasizing they confirm previous studies rather than novel discoveries.

Partial overlap on GATA3 downregulation (C79-C80). OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN due to lack of quantification and speculative connection to cell death (C82). Peer review R7 includes these claims with IKZF2 data in supplementary figures, accepting without specific discussion but noting they are additional analyses in revised manuscript.

Partial overlap on IKZF2 upregulation (C84-C85). OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN due to lack of quantification and unclear mechanism. Peer review R7 includes these claims in supplementary data, accepting them as part of additional analyses without detailed critique.

Minor overlap on cell-autonomous regulation (C63-C64). OpenEval R9 focuses specifically on demonstrating cell-autonomous nature through mosaic analysis, rating SUPPORTED. Peer review R1 includes C64 within broader evaluation of POU4F3 regulation of RBM24, accepting the finding without separate discussion.

OpenEval evaluates Gfi1HA-Cre model validation (C56-C62) as SUPPORTED with multiple validation approaches. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; reviewers do not specifically discuss the model characterization.

OpenEval evaluates normal OHC marker expression in Pou4f3-/- mice (C41-C42, C45-C46, C49-C50) as SUPPORTED, ruling out failed HC formation. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; this supporting data is not specifically discussed by reviewers.

OpenEval rates ATOH1-POU4F3 cooperative regulation (C115-C119) as UNCERTAIN, noting it is based on reanalysis of published data without direct experimental validation. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.

OpenEval rates speculative explanations for negative rescue (C124-C125) as UNCERTAIN, noting they are reasonable hypotheses lacking experimental support. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; these discussion points are not separately evaluated by reviewers.

OpenEval rates AAV gene therapy speculation (C132, C134) as UNCERTAIN, noting no AAV experiments were performed. No corresponding peer review evaluation found, though peer reviewers do mention therapeutic implications of enhancer discovery in R4.

OpenEval evaluates literature context claims (C8-C36, C99-C133) as SUPPORTED, noting they are properly cited established knowledge. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; reviewers do not separately evaluate background literature claims.

OpenEval evaluates POU4F3 expression in Gfi1-/- HCs (C71) as SUPPORTED, establishing epistatic relationship. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; this specific claim is not separately discussed.

OpenEval evaluates prediction subsequently validated by experiment (C73) as SUPPORTED. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; this methodological point is not separately discussed by reviewers.

OpenEval rates speculation about GFI1 isoforms (C123) as UNCERTAIN, noting it is an untested hypothesis. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; this speculative explanation is not discussed by reviewers.
